title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Measurement Tariff Lines: Sensor Mounting Points
content:
Tariff lines for Repair Estimates & Appointments structural measurements — sensor mounting points.

Measuring the driver-assistance sensor mounting points adds a sensor-point add-on to the measurement charge. The add-on is read from the vehicle's ADAS Sensor Calibrations order in completed status and the systems it covered:

| Vehicle's completed calibration order (ADAS Sensor Calibrations) | Sensor-point add-on |
|---|---|
| Covered multiple systems | 50.00 USD |
| Covered a single system (a forward camera, a blind spot radar or a front radar) | 25.00 USD |
| No completed calibration order | none |

A vehicle whose completed network calibration order covered multiple systems adds 50.00 USD, one whose completed calibration order covered a single system adds 25.00 USD, and a vehicle with no completed calibration order adds none.

Hypothetical vehicles: a completed Blind Spot Radar Calibration order covering the blind spot radar alone — 25.00 USD; a completed Multi-System Calibration order covering multiple systems — 50.00 USD; an order still in calibration and not completed — none.
